purpose: Help operations responders select, assign, and resolve active incidents while preserving clear recovery and status feedback.

screens.purpose: Scan the active incident queue and identify an incident requiring action.
Review the selected incident, its operational context, and available actions.
Choose an incident owner and confirm assignment.
Confirm ownership and expose the resolution workflow.
Enter a resolution note and confirm incident resolution.
Confirm the incident is resolved and announce the final status.
Explain that an owner is required and provide a recoverable route back to assignment.
Explain that a resolution note is required and provide a recoverable retry route.

constraints: The public-benchmark trigger resolves execution to Strict mode.
Blocked assignment must explain that an owner is required and remain recoverable.
Failed resolution must explain that a resolution note is required and remain recoverable.
All interactive controls must support keyboard navigation and deterministic visible focus.
Status changes must be announced through a polite live region.
The incident-dispatcher mouse may use action mode only while assigning or resolving.

Default or resting mouse appearances must preserve the chest V/U as the sole default clasped hand pair; only assigning or resolving action mode removes it and uses exactly one coherent action-hand pair with no chest V/U.
Dashboard styling must derive from incident-monitoring needs rather than character or composition references.
No generation, runtime, rendering, visual QA, or acceptance claim is valid without corresponding evidence.
